label.zh: 权重30：工厂开始绑架工人（需≥100名工厂工人）
label.en: Weight 30: the factory starts kidnapping workers (needs 100+ factory workers)

bridges.evidence: 2015 immediate random_list sets colony_factory_kidnap (30) or colony_factory_no_effect (35) (events/colony_events_2.txt:2402-2405); 2016 triggers on colony_factory_kidnap, the d_odd_factory deposit and 100+ odd_factory_worker jobs, MTTH 4 months (2429-2441)

label.zh: 权重35：无事发生，约6个月后收尾
label.en: Weight 35: nothing happens; closing note after about 6 months
Option a: 50% falls back to nothing

notes.zh: 选项b关闭工厂（移除矿藏）并终结故事；选项a继续。因标志在选项b后未清除，但矿藏已移除，触发条件不再满足。
notes.en: Option b shuts the factory (removes the deposit) and ends the story; option a continues. The kidnap flag stays after b but the deposit is gone, so the trigger fails.

scope.zh: 怪异因素：发现工厂，权重30:35决定绑架线或无事线，以及两次绑架的后续。
scope.en: An Odd Factor: factory found, a 30:35 draw between the kidnap line and the nothing-happens line, and the two kidnap follow-ups.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.
